title: John Calvin
source: Public domain. Consolidated from John Calvin, Commentary on the Epistles to the Corinthians, translated by John Pringle, Calvin Translation Society, and the Institutes of the Christian Religion, translated by Henry Beveridge; both as published by the Christian Classics Ethereal Library.
body: John Calvin on Second Corinthians, chapter 2. In his Commentary on the Epistles to the Corinthians, in the John Pringle translation, Calvin writes at Second Corinthians 2, verse 1: I call God for a witness. He now begins to assign a reason for his change of purpose; for hitherto he has merely repelled calumny. In the Institutes of the Christian Religion, in the Henry Beveridge translation, Calvin draws on this chapter again in Book 2, chapter 5.
